name: Detail drawer
summary: A side sheet for one record shown open: name, status, previous and next, the key fields, an attachment and a sticky footer with the two decisions. Where it slides in from is the project's.
use: to open one record from a list without leaving the list
a11y: A labelled dialog region; every icon button (previous, next, close, open file) has an accessible name, fields are a description list, and the footer actions are real buttons.
